title: Puzzle Uo Poko
note: Puzzle game by Cave (CAVE): credits, stage, bubble, bubble_p2 (FinalBurn Neo cheat database). Made by tools/cave_games.py.

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Cave 68000 work RAM from 0x100000 (64 KB), bytes swapped within 16-bit words

stage.note: stage, the value read plus one (FBNeo cheat database, Select Starting Stage)

bubble.note: bubble of player 1 ready to shoot: 0x80 magenta to 0x87 orange (FBNeo cheat database, Select Current Bubble PL1)

bubble_p2.note: bubble of player 2 (FBNeo cheat database, Select Current Bubble PL2)

score.note: player 1 score, a 32-bit number (RetroAchievements leaderboard "Best Score" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, learn it with learn.bat in a two-player game (score2=...)

activity.note: no BIOS says who plays: player 1 plays while these values move, as long as one of the moving ones is read (lives or bombs alone change too seldom)
